motivation: Frozen ZTE v2 adds 10.75% held-out Base residual predictive value versus Base-action-plus-task and 14.41% versus within-task shuffled ZTE, whereas the prior H15 token dual residual did not require exact ZTE alignment and failed closed loop.
relationship_to_old_v14: Not a retry of the old best-v1/legacy-ZTE v14: this candidate uses the trained Base1000, Stage1 v2 recurrent features, a verified Base1000 action cache, no Gaussian NLL auxiliary, and a tighter output trust region.
action_expert_and_vlm: frozen trained Base1000; no PI weight update
zte_bank_retrieval: frozen Stage1 v2 with train95-only bank; task-language retrieval and genuine H15 recurrent phase
trainable: task/context projection, Gaussian-prior network through correction loss, bounded H15 output-residual corrector
action_contract: Base predicts normalized relative EEF16 H50; ZeVA modifies only executed H15; H35 copied exactly from Base
loss: expert H15 MSE + 0.25 clipped expert-minus-Base residual regression + 8 per-example Base-preservation hinge + 0.1 trust-excess penalty outside radius 0.05 + 0.0001 gate-centering; Gaussian NLL weight zero
validation_gate_before_closed_loop: Using all cached validation5 decisions, select earliest of 250/500 with corrected H15 MSE at least 3% below uncorrected Base, >=8 of 10 task means non-worse, and finite residual/gate metrics. No formal test label can choose a checkpoint or scale.
development_closed_loop: Only if validation gate passes, evaluate one selected candidate against Base on a new preregistered, disjoint 10x8 expert-valid seed+seen-language split; require ZeVA at least +4/80 and all episode videos/result audit before formal promotion.
formal_closed_loop: Only if development gate passes, use the frozen original 10x20 paired protocol once, disclose all outcomes, and require ZeVA >= Base+8/200 plus normal Base absolute success rate.
known_limit: Expert-state residual MSE is not on-policy success; prior legacy-ZTE output residual failed on a development split despite offline improvement.
